系统当前启用：%t（详细授权状态由系统设置显示）: Enabled in system: %t (see System Settings for authorization details)
暂无下载，添加一个种子开始吧。: No downloads yet. Add a torrent to begin.
检查是否有新版本，让 Rivu 保持最新。: Check for a new version to keep Rivu up to date.
无下载、校验或做种任务时安装: Install when no downloads, checks, or seeding are active
自动安装默认关闭。安装前会保存会话，完成后由你决定重启。: Automatic installation is off by default. Your session is saved before installing; you choose when to restart.
在菜单栏显示 Rivu: Show Rivu in the menu bar
登录后继续下载，不打开主窗口: Continue downloads at login without opening a window
避免意外中断下载和做种: Avoid interrupting downloads and seeding by accident
关闭主窗口后，下载会继续。\n从 Rivu 菜单选择“退出 Rivu”可结束应用:
Downloads continue after you close the main window.
Choose “Quit Rivu” from the Rivu menu to exit.
限速单位为字节/秒，0 表示不限速。\n分享率 -1 表示无限做种，0 表示完成:
Limits are in bytes/second; 0 means unlimited.
Share ratio: -1 seeds forever; 0 stops on completion.
连接设置在下次启动生效。未知磁力链接仅使用指定 Tracker 或节点获取元数据: Connection changes apply on next launch. Unknown magnets use only specified trackers or peers to fetch metadata.
完成后，轻轻提醒你: A gentle reminder when a download is ready
需要处理时及时提醒: Let you know when action is needed
可在系统设置 → 通知中管理 Rivu。通知是否送达取决于系统授权和专注模式。: Manage Rivu in System Settings → Notifications. Delivery depends on permission and Focus settings.
设置已保存；连接设置将在下次启动生效: Settings saved; connection changes apply on next launch
选择一个任务以查看详细信息。: Select a transfer to see its details.
分享率达到 %.1f 时自动停止: Stop automatically at a share ratio of %.1f
等待元数据，文件列表尚不可用。: Waiting for metadata. File list is not available yet.
跨文件分片可能占用未选择文件的少量空间。: Pieces spanning multiple files may use some space in unselected files.
Tracker 地址已隐藏凭据。当前引擎接口未提供逐 Tracker 的公告结果: Tracker credentials are hidden. The engine does not expose per-tracker announce results.
将种子文件拖到这里，或粘贴磁力链接: Drop torrent files here, or paste a magnet link
添加种子文件或磁力链接，Rivu 会在后台继续下载。: Add a torrent or magnet link. Rivu keeps downloading in the background.
试试其他分类，或清除搜索内容。: Try another category or clear your search.
文件列表和大小待获取: Waiting for file list and size
默认保留已下载文件。移到废纸篓只处理这些任务拥有的文件。: Downloaded files are kept by default. Only files owned by these transfers will be moved to Trash.
同时将下载文件移到废纸篓: Also move downloaded files to Trash
下载和做种将中断。下次启动会按设置恢复。关闭主窗口可以继续在后台下载。: Downloads and seeding will stop and resume on next launch according to your settings. Close the main window to keep downloading in the background.
修复后重新读取会话与设置: Reload Session and Settings After Repair
无法保存会话，已取消退出: %w: Could not save session; quit canceled: %w
设置读取失败，原文件已保留: %w: Could not read settings; original file preserved: %w
请添加种子文件或磁力链接: Add a torrent file or magnet link
请确认保存位置和文件选择: Review the save location and file selection
已选择种子文件，请读取并审阅: Torrent files selected. Read and review them.
已粘贴，请读取并审阅: Pasted. Read and review the sources.
导入已处理；错误项目可修改后重新读取: Import processed. Fix failed items and read them again.
将新的内容，带到你的 Mac。: Bring something new to your Mac.
也可以选择本地 .torrent 文件。: You can also choose local .torrent files.
元数据待获取。开始后将下载全部文件；取消立即开始可先保存为暂停任务。: Metadata is pending. Starting downloads all files; turn off immediate start to add a paused transfer first.
下载完成后继续做种，分享率达到 %.1f 时停止。: Keep seeding after download; stop at a share ratio of %.1f.
语言在保存设置后生效。: Language changes apply when you save settings.
会话无法读取，原文件已保留: %w: Could not read session; original file preserved: %w
目标路径已由另一个任务使用: Another transfer is using the destination path
正在保存会话，请稍后重试: Saving session. Please try again shortly.
会话保存失败，请重试: %w: Could not save session. Please retry: %w
暂停尚未保存，请重试: Pause has not been saved. Please retry.
元数据与现有任务重复，请移除此任务: Metadata duplicates an existing transfer. Remove this transfer.
文件由其他任务共享，无法移到废纸篓: Files are shared by other transfers and cannot be moved to Trash
文件已被符号链接替换: File has been replaced with a symbolic link
只允许移除任务的普通文件: Only regular files owned by the transfer can be removed
磁力链接缺少有效 infohash: Magnet link has no valid infohash
未解析的磁力链接需要 Tracker 或明确的节点地址；获取元数据前禁用 DHT: Unresolved magnets need a tracker or explicit peer address; DHT/PEX is disabled until metadata is fetched
文件已被替换或不属于该任务: %s: File replaced or not owned by this transfer: %s
请选择绝对路径的下载目录: Choose an absolute download folder path
下载路径不是目录: Download path is not a folder
请选择真实目录，不能使用符号链接: Choose a real folder, not a symbolic link
目标已存在或不安全，请选择另一个目录: %s: Destination exists or is unsafe. Choose another folder: %s
此安装未配置签名更新源，或安装位置不可写。可前往 GitHub 查看发行版。: No signed update source is configured, or the installation is not writable. Check releases on GitHub.
没有可安装的更新: No update is available to install
此下载已在引擎中运行: This download is already running in the engine
下载尚未接入引擎: Download has not been added to the engine
文件选择与元数据不一致: File selection does not match metadata
download destination must be absolute: Download destination must be an absolute path
concurrent downloads must be 1–32: Concurrent downloads must be between 1 and 32
接管已有文件并校验（保留其删除权限）: Adopt and verify existing files (never trash them)
磁盘空间不足，请释放空间或重新定位目录。: Disk full. Free space or choose another location.
下载目录不可用，请连接磁盘或重新定位目录。: Destination unavailable. Connect the disk or choose another location.
元数据获取失败，请检查来源后重试。: Metadata failed. Check the source and retry.
保存失败，请修复目录权限或空间后重新读取。: Save failed. Fix permissions or disk space, then reload.
任务异常，请检查文件和连接后重试。: Transfer failed. Check files and connectivity, then retry.
不会移动原目录文件。新目录中的已有数据将被校验并保留删除权限；缺失或损坏的数据将: Files in the original folder stay in place. Existing data in the new folder is verified and never trashed. Missing or damaged data downloads when the task runs.
普通限速为 0 时不限速；临时限速必须大于 0。: Normal limits of 0 mean unlimited; temporary limits must be positive.
每天按本地时间启用临时限速，支持跨午夜。: Apply temporary limits daily in local time, including overnight.
稳定的种子文件会自动导入默认下载目录；原文件保留。: Stable torrent files import to the default destination; source files are kept.
自动策略不会恢复手动暂停的任务。做种时长只累计实际做种时间。: Automatic policies respect manual pauses. Seeding time counts only active seeding.
等待节点：请检查网络和 Tracker，或稍后重试。: Waiting for peers. Check the network and trackers, or retry later.
Tracker 地址已隐藏凭据；诊断每 5 秒刷新。: Tracker credentials are hidden; diagnostics refresh every 5 seconds.
